puzzles.name: Child Link - Silver Gauntlets
puzzles.description: As Child Link, navigate small passages to reach Silver Gauntlets. Required for Adult Link puzzles.
steps: Play Requiem of Spirit as Adult
Bombchu through hole to hit switch
hints: Nabooru: "Only a child can reach them..."

puzzles.name: Adult Link - Mirror Shield
puzzles.description: As Adult Link, use Silver Gauntlets to move heavy blocks and reach Mirror Shield.
steps: Use Silver Gauntlets to push silver blocks

puzzles.name: Anubis Mirror Puzzle
puzzles.description: Anubis mirrors movements and is invulnerable to physical attacks. Use Din's Fire to damage.
steps: Cast Din's Fire - AoE damages Anubis

puzzles.name: Iron Knuckle Mini-Boss
puzzles.description: Heavy armored enemy. Attack removes armor pieces. Helmet falls off revealing weak point.

puzzles.name: Beamos Laser Puzzle
puzzles.description: Redirect Beamos lasers with Mirror Shield to hit switches and open doors.

puzzles.name: Armored Statue Puzzle
puzzles.description: Push massive armored statues with Silver/Golden Gauntlets onto switches.

puzzles.name: Twinrova Mirror Shield Battle
puzzles.description: Reflect Kotake's fire and Koume's ice with Mirror Shield. Absorb 3 of each, then reflect combined beam.
steps: Kotake (fire) shoots fire - reflect with shield
Koume (ice) shoots ice - reflect with shield

phases.name: Separate Sisters
phases.mechanic: Kotake (fire) and Koume (ice) attack from platforms
phases.puzzle: Mirror Shield absorb 3 fire + 3 ice attacks

phases.name: Twinrova Merged
phases.mechanic: Merged form alternates fire/ice, creates floor hazards
phases.puzzle: Reflect combined elemental beam, attack while stunned

phases.name: Desperation
phases.mechanic: Low health - faster attacks, floor lava/ice
phases.puzzle: Quick reflects, Iron Boots for floor hazards
